classification_policy.DIRECT_CAUSAL_ORIGIN: The commit itself introduces a complete exploitable chain or the direct unsafe sink/source state in this DAG.
classification_policy.COMPOSITIONAL_CAUSAL_CONTRIBUTOR: The commit introduces a necessary or materially enabling source, activation, or privilege component that is dangerous in composition.
classification_policy.NONCAUSAL: The inspected delta does not create or materially enlarge the first exploit path; carrier-only, formatting, or mitigating changes are noncausal.
classification_policy.INCONCLUSIVE: The local history proves adjacency or origin of changed code but does not prove exploitability or causal necessity.

protocol.uncertainty_rule: No unreviewed or mechanism-uncertain edge is promoted above INCONCLUSIVE.

causal_obligations.mechanism: This root already contains the one-click local-file chain: ChatBox stores a clicked output file and switches to documentWorkSpace; Folder observes selectedFile and invokes open-file; HTML open-file returns the path; Folder embeds localfile:// HTML; the main window has webSecurity=false and nodeIntegration=true; preload exposes unrestricted ipcRenderer.invoke/send plus electronAPI.executeCommand; main handles execute-command by spawning attacker-controlled command and serves .html through the localfile protocol.

per_fix_edges.rationale: The complete unsafe local HTML-to-IPC-to-spawn path exists in this root and survives to the first fix.
It is the root of the privileged renderer bridge and command capability retained through the second hardening edge; the exact sanitizer bypass addressed by e21f82 is not independently executed here.

causal_obligations.candidate_subject: feat: add support for loading remote files
causal_obligations.mechanism: Adds downloadFile/isLocalFile/getTempFilePath and makes open-file download an http(s) URL into app temp before the existing HTML path-return and localfile iframe render. The parent already obtains item.url from /api/chat/files but cannot serve that URL through localfile; this delta materializes attacker-controlled remote HTML into the active local preview path.

per_fix_edges.rationale: It materially enables the remote-file source but needs the pre-existing active HTML sink and privileged IPC bridge.
The remote untrusted-content source persists into the second hardening edge.

causal_obligations.mechanism: After 4e38cf removed the old selectedFile observer, this commit rewrites file-list loading and newly looks up chatStoreSelectedFile by name, then calls selecetdFileChange. That restores automatic opening of the chat-selected local or remote output and is not described by its commit subject.

per_fix_edges.rationale: It restores the one-click activation edge but depends on the unsafe preview and IPC capability.
The activation edge is retained through the second fix lineage.

causal_obligations.mechanism: This parentless root imports the complete vulnerable snapshot. Pre-fix blame attributes the HTML iframe/raw-HTML preview and ChatBox click path to this root, while its fileReader blob is byte-identical to 4e38cf's post-change blob. It is therefore a direct DAG origin and a squash/import carrier; it must not erase the earlier ordinary origins 4e38cf and 81d593.

per_fix_edges.rationale: With no parent, the root directly introduces the complete vulnerable state into its DAG and owns the surviving unsafe sink lines by blame.
It directly imports the untrusted source and active-preview lineage, while the exact residual sanitizer bypass at e21f82 is not independently executed here.

causal_obligations.candidate_subject: fix: navigation when opening output file from chat ( #255)
causal_obligations.mechanism: Persists opened files to chatStore and adds a selectedFile.path effect that finds the selected output and invokes selectedFileChange/open-file. This makes chat-output navigation automatically open a newly selected file even when the Folder workspace is already mounted.

per_fix_edges.rationale: It materially broadens reliability of the one-click activation path without creating the sink or privilege primitive.
The same automatic-open behavior remains in the second fix ancestry.

causal_obligations.candidate_subject: enhance:navigation when opening output file from chat
causal_obligations.mechanism: Changes selected output matching from non-unique name to exact path and adds fileGroups/source-mode/task dependencies, making the automatic open select the intended output and retrigger after file-list population.

per_fix_edges.rationale: It makes the already introduced one-click path reliable and path-correct; it is not merely cosmetic.
The refined activation path remains in the second fix ancestry.

causal_obligations.candidate_subject: fix:Prevent XSS in FolderComponent and block ipcRenderer injection
causal_obligations.mechanism: Creates FolderComponent with DOMPurify and a literal case-sensitive raw.includes('ipcRenderer') check; e21f82 later replaces that check with broader case-insensitive patterns and stricter forbidden tags/attributes. History proves code provenance, but without executing a bypass it does not prove that 442830 introduced an exploitable residual RCE rather than an incomplete or defense-in-depth fix.
causal_obligations.scope_exclusion: It is the first fix itself, not a predecessor candidate for its own fix edge.

per_fix_edges.rationale: Exact sanitizer-policy provenance is direct, but exploitability and causal necessity of the broadened textual block list are not proven from history alone.

evidence.fact: Fix 442830 changes HTML handling from returning a file path plus localfile iframe to reading content plus FolderComponent sanitization; e21f82 broadens dangerous-pattern and DOMPurify restrictions.
Pre-fix blame assigns the HTML localfile iframe and raw dangerouslySetInnerHTML sink to parentless root 723df5a0.
Pre-fix preload lines 4-20 expose unrestricted ipcRenderer send/invoke; blame assigns them to parentless root f6dd4268.
Pre-fix main process execute-command handler imports child_process, splits a renderer-provided command, and calls spawn; core lines blame to f6dd4268.
Pre-fix BrowserWindow uses webSecurity=false, nodeIntegration=true, contextIsolation=true; localfile protocol decodes an arbitrary path and serves .html as text/html.
The f6dd4268 root ChatBox click stores the file and switches to documentWorkSpace; Folder's selectedFile effect invokes open-file; HTML returns its path and is embedded via localfile iframe.
4e38cf adds HTTP(S) download into app temp and then continues normal openFile processing; its parent already obtains remote item.url but lacks that materialization step.
4e38cf and 723df5a0 resolve electron/main/fileReader.ts to the same blob a96e79799a437cedc52a4fbbd1706a41b8806974.
81d593 rewrites file-list loading and newly calls selecetdFileChange for chatStoreSelectedFile; 4e38cf had deleted the older direct selectedFile effect.
723df5a0 is a parentless root; 5d88044a is the first descendant containing both unrelated roots. Relevant-file diffs from 5d88044a to either parent are empty.
The f6dd4268, 4e38cf, 81d593, 723df5a0, fecaf6, and 0747c10 commits are ancestors of both supplied fixes.
fecaf6 adds persistence plus a selectedFile.path effect that reopens the selected output; 0747c10 switches lookup from name to path and adds dependencies required after file-list population.
fecaf6 is the direct child of tag v0.0.60 commit cf003632; 0747c10 descends from fecaf6; both are ancestors of tag v0.0.61 commit 624f7de.
442830 creates FolderComponent with DOMPurify plus a case-sensitive raw.includes('ipcRenderer') block.

e21f82 changes that component to case-insensitive ipcRenderer/parent/top/frames/electron patterns and a broader forbidden tag/attribute policy; this proves hardening provenance but not a working bypass.
The frozen Eigent schedule contains exactly two candidate units. Each carries both fix edges, so the full top-10-per-fix union is two units and four edges.
The two scheduled units are Claude-attributed merge commits 482f2658 and d1bf5a0a. Every one of the six Stage A causal commits is already an ancestor of every merge parent.

482f2658 resolves BottomInput/merge UI behavior and leaves the output-file click blamed to 723df5a0. d1bf5a0a resolves i18n/UI plus duplicate-open guards and a React key; neither introduces a vulnerability mechanism.

Structural ranks for fix 442830 are 723df5a0=1, 0747c10d=2, f6dd4268=4, fecaf6f4=10, 4e38cf8c=26, 81d59319=35. For fix e21f82, 723df5a0=2, f6dd4268=7, 4e38cf8c=25, while 81d59319/fecaf6f4/0747c10d are absent.
